import ctypes, json, random, resource, sys, time
ctypes.CDLL('/workspace/vendor/system-libs/libz.so.1', mode=ctypes.RTLD_GLOBAL)
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/vendor'); sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/submission')
from netnomos.finite import compile_batch
from stress import make_job, usize

jobs = []
configs = [([2]*16, 1), ([256,256], 1), ([65536], 1), ([4]*4, 2), ([2]*8, 2), ([2]*4, 4)]
for i,(sizes,K) in enumerate(configs):
    assert usize(sizes,K)==65536, (sizes,K,usize(sizes,K))
    jobs.append(make_job(sizes, K, 32, 4, 20000//6, 256//6 + (1 if i==0 else 0), 'random', seed=i))
t=time.time(); res=compile_batch({'jobs':jobs}); dt=time.time()-t
print('batch(6 jobs, sum U=393216 > bound) time %.2fs rules=%s' % (dt, [len(r['rules']) for r in res['results']]))
print('peak RSS MiB %.1f' % (resource.getrusage(resource.RUSAGE_SELF).ru_maxrss/1024))
print('output KiB', len(json.dumps(res))//1024)

# protocol-bounded batch: two jobs of U=65536 each = 131072 total
jobs2 = jobs[:2]
t=time.time(); res2=compile_batch({'jobs':jobs2}); dt=time.time()-t
